grid.coordinates: top-left origin; x right; y down

placement_rules.visual_bounds: pixel-art draw rectangle; may extend above the collision footprint
placement_rules.anchor: bottom_center at the grounded foot or base line
placement_rules.collision_footprint: a per-asset grid mask traced from the actual solid ground-contact/base area; never use a category default or the full visual rectangle
placement_rules.interaction_cells: explicit standing cells, separate from blocking cells
placement_rules.depth_sort: sort raised props and buildings by the grounded foot line, not the sprite top
placement_rules.no_stretch: art must be authored to its declared aspect ratio; never stretch a square atlas cell into a tall prop

farmhouse_tiers.label: 初始小屋
farmhouse_tiers.collision_basis: one bottom foundation row across eight occupied 32px cells, traced from the visible stone base; roof and upper walls are visual overhang

farmhouse_tiers.label: 扩建小屋
farmhouse_tiers.collision_basis: trace only actual solid foundation cells after final sprite is aligned to the 32px grid; do not use the visual bounds as a preset

farmhouse_tiers.label: 大型农舍
farmhouse_tiers.collision_basis: trace only actual solid foundation cells after final sprite is aligned to the 32px grid; do not use the visual bounds as a preset

well_v1.footprint_measurement: the solid stone base reaches the ground across the three bottom-row cells of the 3x4 visual canvas; the roof and upper rim remain visual overhang
well_v1.notes: The roof, pulley, and posts are visible overhang. Only cells covered by the solid stone base enter the footprint mask.

tree_large_v1.collision_basis: trace actual trunk/root ground-contact cells; do not infer from canopy size or assume one cell

shipping_bin_v1.collision_basis: trace actual box base ground-contact cells after sprite alignment; do not assume a 2x1 preset

spring.palette_direction: fresh leaf greens, soft pink and cream blossoms, warm light soil

summer.palette_direction: full deeper greens, sun-warmed ochre paths, saturated crop greens

fall.palette_direction: amber, rust, muted olive foliage, dry warm paths and harvest accents

winter.palette_direction: snow-covered surfaces and roofs, blue-gray shadows, dark evergreen anchors

seasonal_invariants: all seasonal variants keep identical visual dimensions, anchor, collision footprint, and interaction cells
seasonal swaps change color, foliage, snow, blossoms, and small decorations; they do not silently move walkable paths or doors
water remains non-walkable in every season unless a separate frozen-water gameplay rule explicitly changes navigation
